project.name: Northwind Launch
project.description: Launch of Northwind's new smart-home product line, delivered by a team where everyone works through their own AI agent.

docs.title: Northwind Launch brief
docs.body:
# Northwind Launch

We are launching **Northwind Hub**, a smart-home hub that learns your routines and recommends products that fit your home.

## Milestones
- **3 Oct: MVP ready** (API, recommendations, onboarding UI)
- **17 Oct: Beta** with 10 customers
- **31 Oct: Public launch**

## How we work
- Every task is owned by a person who works through their own AI agent.
- Agents report progress with an explanation of **how** the work was done, which sub-agents they used, and what it cost.
- Juniors submit, seniors approve. Nobody approves their own work.

## Success metrics
- 10 beta customers onboarded
- Search p95 under 2 s
- Recommendation precision@10 above 0.35
docs.author: layla

docs.title: API design conventions
docs.body:
# API conventions

- REST + JSON, kebab-case paths, versioned under `/v1`
- Errors: `{ "error": "message" }` with a proper status code (400, 401, 403, 404)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request
- Pagination: `?page=` and `?limit=` (max 100)
- Every endpoint has a test; CI must be green before review
docs.author: sara

docs.title: Brand voice guide
docs.body:
# Brand voice

Warm, confident, no jargon. **Lead with the benefit, then the feature.**

| Say | Don't say |
|---|---|
| "Your home, one tap away" | "Unified IoT control plane" |
| "Set up in 5 minutes" | "Frictionless onboarding" |
| "Picks products that fit your home" | "AI-powered recommendations" |

Short sentences. Talk to one person ("you").
docs.author: tom

docs.title: Architecture decision records
docs.body:
# Architecture decision records

1. **SQLite for the pilot, Postgres at launch.** One file is enough for 10 beta customers; we migrate before 31 Oct.
2. **Recommendations run as a nightly batch job.** Results are stored per product and served by the API.
3. **Full-text search inside the database** (FTS) instead of a separate search service, until traffic proves otherwise.
docs.author: sara

docs.title: Launch budget FY27

# Budget (confidential)

- Engineering: €180k

- AI usage cap: €4k/month

tasks.title: Define MVP scope & success metrics
tasks.description: Agree what is in the MVP and how we measure success.
tasks.scope: In: MVP feature list, success metrics, milestone dates. Out: pricing (T-12).

tasks.title: Architecture review
tasks.description: Review the system design against the ADRs before the beta: service boundaries, data flow and the main scaling risks. Findings go to the PM with a go/no-go for M-1.
tasks.scope: In: API, recommendation batch job, data pipeline. Out: frontend.

tasks.title: Set up data pipeline for product catalog
tasks.description: Import the product catalog nightly into the API database, with validation so bad rows never reach the API.
tasks.scope: In: import + validation. Out: pricing logic.

tasks.title: Build product API
tasks.description: REST API for products, search (T-11) and auth (T-10), used by the onboarding UI (T-6). Recommendations from T-5 are served through it.
tasks.scope: In: products, search, auth, recommendations endpoint, OpenAPI spec. Out: payments.

tasks.title: Auth endpoints
tasks.description: Sign-up, login and token refresh for the product API.
tasks.scope: In: JWT access + refresh tokens, password reset. Out: social login.

tasks.title: Search endpoint
tasks.description: Full-text product search with filters for category and price, paginated.
tasks.scope: In: `GET /products/search`, filters, tests. Out: ranking by recommendations.

tasks.title: Recommendation model v1
tasks.description: First recommendation model. Serve results through the product API (T-4).
tasks.scope: In: offline training, evaluation (precision@10), a recommendations endpoint in T-4. Out: real-time retraining.

tasks.title: Onboarding UI
tasks.description: Sign-up and device pairing screens for beta customers, built on the product API (T-4). Shows the first recommendations after pairing.
tasks.scope: In: sign-up, login, pair a hub, home screen with recommendations. Out: settings, billing.

tasks.title: Integration tests & CI
tasks.description: End-to-end tests for the product API (T-4) and a CI pipeline that runs them on every push, so the beta never ships a broken endpoint.
tasks.scope: In: API tests (auth, products, search, recommendations), CI workflow, test report. Out: load tests (T-14).

tasks.title: Beta landing page copy
tasks.description: Landing page for beta sign-ups, in the brand voice.
tasks.scope: In: headline, 3 benefit blocks, sign-up form copy, A/B test of 2 headlines. Out: design.

tasks.title: Beta customer onboarding kit
tasks.description: Guide + email sequence for beta customers, including how recommendations work.
tasks.scope: In: setup guide, 3 welcome emails, FAQ. Out: video tutorials.

tasks.title: Pricing research
tasks.description: Competitor pricing and willingness-to-pay research, as input for the launch price decision.
tasks.scope: In: 6 competitors, price tiers, a survey of 200 waitlist sign-ups. Out: final price (PM decision).

tasks.title: Launch announcement & press kit
tasks.description: Launch announcement, press kit and journalist outreach for the public launch, built on the winning landing page copy (T-8) and the onboarding kit (T-9).
tasks.scope: In: announcement, fact sheet, product images, outreach list. Out: paid ads.

tasks.title: Load testing
tasks.description: Load test the product API (T-4) before the public launch: find the breaking point and make sure search and recommendations stay fast under launch traffic.
tasks.scope: In: load scripts for 1,000 concurrent users, p95 latency report, fixes for the top bottleneck. Out: frontend performance.

history.summary: Drafted MVP scope with a **research agent** (competitor features) and a **writer agent** (scope doc). Success metrics: 10 beta customers, <2 s search.
Generated the import script with a **coding agent**; a **test agent** wrote 14 validation tests.
Pipeline runs nightly; 12,480 products imported, 0 validation errors. Used 2 agents (coding, test). Ready for T-4 and T-5.
JWT auth endpoints with refresh tokens; 9 tests green.
Product endpoints done (`GET /products`, `GET /products/:id`). Search (T-11) next; T-5 will consume the recommendations endpoint.
Trained a baseline collaborative-filtering model with a **data agent**; offline precision@10 = 0.31. Will expose it through T-4.
Reviewed service boundaries against the ADRs; flagged the recommendation batch job as the main scaling risk.
Collected pricing for 6 competitors with a **web research agent**.
Wrote 2 headline variants with a **copywriting agent**, ran a quick A/B on the waitlist page.

Final copy ready. Variant **B** won the A/B test (4.2% vs 3.1% sign-up).

![A/B test results](/api/artifacts/a1b2c3d4e5f60718)

Used a **copywriting agent** for drafts and an **analytics agent** for the test readout.
